name: build_playbook_on_alert_page
note: Defect box 159 sess-dmrfucve: a 'build a playbook' request typed on a triage-pinned Alert page must author a playbook, not investigate and force a verdict card.
message: Build a playbook to automate these tasks: validate SIEM details for case 31885, enrich CMDB for the host, monitor for correlated alerts

name: save_that_as_a_playbook_promotes_to_build
note: 'Save that as a playbook' promotes a triage page to build (routing). As a single first turn there is no prior trace to save, so the card is context-dependent; assert routing + that it does not dead-end on a verdict, not a specific offer.

name: triage_question_naming_a_playbook_stays_triage
note: Precision guard: naming a playbook in a question must NOT flip to build.
message: Which playbook already ran on this alert?

name: plain_triage_action_stays_triage
note: A containment ask is triage, not authoring. It stages the block; it does not hunt or write a verdict (demo: a block ask ran a full investigation).
message: Block the IP associated with this alert

name: build_request_with_no_intent_pin
note: No widget pin, a record page (triage prior) + a build message -> build.
message: Create a playbook that blocks a malicious IP using FortiGate

name: bare_block_ip_stages_action_in_english
note: Demo: 'block ip <addr>' hunted, enriched, answered in German, and never staged the block. A bare command names no language; the reply stays English.

name: block_named_ip_on_fortigate
note: Worked in an earlier demo; pin it.
message: Block this ip on my fortigate 198.51.100.50

name: attack_timeline_stays_english
note: Demo: the timeline's verdict card came back in Spanish.
message: Build an attack timeline for this alert -- order the key events and explain how the activity progressed.
